int_name: N BROAD ST & SPRING GARDEN ST

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with multi-lane traffic and basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, signals, and marked crosswalks. While functional, the significant crossing distance and lack of physical protection like medians or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to vehicles.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk lines are worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Pavement Cracking
hazards.description: Visible cracks and wear in the asphalt within the intersection area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace standard transverse markings with continental or ladder style markings to improve visibility for drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a median or refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The intersection features wide multi-lane roadways with marked zebra crosswalks and a substantial median refuge area. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps and sidewalks are in good condition, the overall scale is car-centric with long crossing distances and a lack of traffic-calming elements like street trees.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide lanes and a lack of vertical friction like trees encourage higher vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Planting trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical buffer and naturally slow traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install visible pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: The intersection features wide multi-lane roadways with significant crossing distances, increasing pedestrian exposure. While marked crosswalks and signals are present, the overall scale is prioritized for vehicle throughput.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway creates a long, unprotected crossing distance, increasing exposure time to vehicles.

hazards.name: Multi-lane Threat

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area and break up the long crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The intersection features standard pedestrian infrastructure including marked crosswalks, signals, and sidewalks, but is characterized by a very wide roadway with multiple travel lanes. This design results in long crossing distances and high exposure for pedestrians in a high-density urban environment.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The width of the roadway forces pedestrians to remain in the conflict zone for an extended period.
hazards.location_in_image: Main crossing across the multi-lane street

hazards.name: Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Large vehicles stopped near the intersection can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the foreground roadway

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and provide a physical barrier.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.
